Package com.skyblockexp.ezframework.plugin.config

Class GlobalConfig

java.lang.Object
com.skyblockexp.ezframework.plugin.config.GlobalConfig
public final class GlobalConfig extends Object
Reads the manager plugin's own global config from plugins/EzFramework/config.yml.

Supported keys:

  • github-owner — GitHub organisation/user that owns the release repository (default: ez-plugins)
  • github-repo — repository name (default: EzFramework)
  • modules-dir — directory where module JARs are cached (default: plugins/EzFramework/modules)

      public static GlobalConfig load(File dataFolder) throws IOException
      Load the global config from dataFolder/config.yml. Falls back to defaults when the file does not exist or a key is absent.
      Parameters:
      dataFolder - plugin data folder
      Returns:
      parsed config
      Throws:
      IOException - on read errors (file existence errors are silently ignored and defaults substituted)
